youtube_seo.description:
On 13 November 2026, India's top CFOs declared that traditional ROI no longer applies to AI. Girish Goenka of Piramal Realty called it an existence test. This episode unpacks the new three-part scorecard of efficiency, growth, and strategy, with evidence from HPE, McKinsey, Swiggy, and Happilo. Teaching case PDF included.
